==================

==================
Starred operands in comma lists
==================

_ = a, *[x]
_ = *(y), z
for i in *{1}, 2: pass
---

(module
  (expression_statement
    (assignment
      (identifier)
      (expression_list
        (identifier)
        (list_splat
          (list
            (identifier))))))
  (expression_statement
    (assignment
      (identifier)
      (expression_list
        (list_splat
          (parenthesized_expression
            (identifier)))
        (identifier))))
  (for_statement
    (identifier)
    (expression_list
      (list_splat
        (set
          (integer)))
      (integer))
    (block
      (pass_statement))))

==================

==================

x = *a, b

---

  (expression_statement
    (assignment
      (identifier)
      (expression_list
        (identifier)
        (list_splat
          (identifier)))))
  (expression_statement
    (assignment
      (identifier)
      (expression_list
        (list_splat
          (identifier))
        (identifier))))
  (expression_statement
    (subscript
      (identifier)
      (list_splat
        (identifier)))))
